title: Concept: Apache server-info page served
description: server-info prints the module list with versions and the paths of the configuration files. Combined with mod_status it also reveals the traffic of each virtual host, so the pair is a configuration audit of the server performed by the caller.
applicability: Responses from an Apache host that leaves the info handler enabled.
risk: The caller learns the loaded modules and their versions, and the configuration layout of the host.
